title: Dog Barking at the Moon
description: A stylized depiction of a dog barking at a full moon in a serene night sky. The dog is a brown silhouette, head tilted upwards, with subtle lines indicating the bark. The moon is a bright yellow circle with slight crater details, set against a deep blue to black gradient sky filled with twinkling stars. The foreground features dark, rolling hills.
svg_content:
<svg width="800" height="600" viewBox="0 0 800 600" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="skyGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#0A1128;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#00010c;stop-opacity:1" />
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="moonGlow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%" fx="50%" fy="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:rgb(255,255,200);stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:rgb(200,200,150);stop-opacity:0" />
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Night Sky -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="800" height="600" fill="url(#skyGradient)" />

  <!-- Ground -->
  <path d="M0 600 L0 450 C200 400, 600 400, 800 450 L800 600 Z" fill="#2D2D2D" />
  <path d="M0 600 L0 500 C200 470, 600 470, 800 500 L800 600 Z" fill="#1A1A1A" />

  <!-- Moon -->
  <circle cx="650" cy="150" r="80" fill="#FDFD96" stroke="#e0e080" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="630" cy="130" r="15" fill="#e0e080" />
  <circle cx="680" cy="170" r="10" fill="#e0e080" />
  <circle cx="660" cy="100" r="8" fill="#e0e080" />

  <!-- Stars -->
  <circle cx="100" cy="50" r="2" fill="white" />
  <circle cx="50" cy="120" r="1.5" fill="white" />
  <circle cx="200" cy="80" r="2.5" fill="white" />
  <circle cx="300" cy="30" r="1.8" fill="white" />
  <circle cx="450" cy="70" r="2" fill="white" />
  <circle cx="750" cy="50" r="1.5" fill="white" />
  <circle cx="550" cy="10" r="1.2" fill="white" />

  <!-- Dog (simplified silhouette) -->
  <g transform="translate(200, 350)">
    <!-- Body -->
    <path d="M50 150 C20 120, 0 80, 20 50 L100 50 C120 20, 180 20, 200 50 L250 80 C280 100, 280 140, 250 160 L150 170 Z" fill="#8B4513" />
    <!-- Head -->
    <path d="M220 50 C250 20, 280 30, 270 70 C260 90, 230 100, 200 90 Z" fill="#8B4513" />
    <!-- Snout -->
    <path d="M270 70 C280 60, 290 60, 290 70 C290 80, 280 80, 270 70 Z" fill="#5A2E0C" />
    <!-- Ear 1 -->
    <path d="M220 50 Q200 30, 200 10 L230 0 Q250 20, 250 40 Z" fill="#8B4513" stroke="#5A2E0C" stroke-width="2"/>
     <!-- Ear 2 (hidden or partially visible) -->
    <path d="M210 55 Q195 35, 195 15 L225 5 Q240 25, 240 45 Z" fill="#8B4513" stroke="#5A2E0C" stroke-width="2" transform="rotate(-10 210 55)"/>

    <!-- Tail -->
    <path d="M70 165 C50 180, 40 200, 60 210 C80 220, 100 200, 100 180 Z" fill="#8B4513" />
    <!-- Legs (simplified) -->
    <rect x="80" y="160" width="20" height="40" fill="#8B4513" />
    <rect x="120" y="160" width="20" height="40" fill="#8B4513" />
    <rect x="180" y="160" width="20" height="40" fill="#8B4513" />
    <rect x="220" y="160" width="20" height="40" fill="#8B4513" />
  </g>
   <!-- Barking sound lines -->
  <path d="M480 400 L500 380 M490 405 L515 385 M485 395 L505 375" stroke="white" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none" transform="rotate(-20 490 400) translate(-30, -50)" />

</svg>

title: Baby Dragon and Glowing Crystal
description: An adorable baby dragon, with large, innocent eyes and soft, scales in hues of lavender and teal, is curled protectively around a radiant, multi-faceted crystal. The crystal glows with an ethereal light, casting soft reflections on the dragon's scales. The background is a soft, magical blur of gentle purples and blues.
svg_content:
<svg width="800" height="600" viewBox="0 0 800 600" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="backgroundGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#A0C4FF;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#B388EB;stop-opacity:1" />
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="crystalGlow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%" fx="50%" fy="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:rgb(255,255,255);stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="50%" style="stop-color:rgb(173,216,230);stop-opacity:0.8" />
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:rgb(135,206,250);stop-opacity:0" />
    </radialGradient>
    <filter id="glow">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="5" result="coloredBlur"/>
      <feMerge>
        <feMergeNode in="coloredBlur"/>
        <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
      </feMerge>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="800" height="600" fill="url(#backgroundGradient)" />

  <!-- Crystal (with glow effect) -->
  <g transform="translate(400, 300)" filter="url(#glow)">
    <path d="M0 -70 L60 -30 L40 50 L-40 50 L-60 -30 Z" fill="#87CEEB" stroke="#ADD8E6" stroke-width="3"/>
    <path d="M0 -70 L-20 -50 L-40 50 L0 30 Z" fill="#B0E0E6"/>
    <path d="M0 -70 L20 -50 L40 50 L0 30 Z" fill="#ADD8E6"/>
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="80" fill="url(#crystalGlow)" opacity="0.7"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Baby Dragon -->
  <g transform="translate(400, 300)">
    <!-- Main Body -->
    <path d="M-100 0 Q-150 -150, -20 20 C100 150, 200 100, 150 -50 C100 -150, -50 -100, -100 0 Z" fill="#9370DB" stroke="#8A2BE2" stroke-width="3"/>
    <!-- Belly -->
    <path d="M-80 -10 Q-100 -50, -20 10 C50 80, 100 50, 80 -20 Z" fill="#BAA2DE" opacity="0.8"/>
    <!-- Head -->
    <ellipse cx="120" cy="-80" rx="50" ry="40" fill="#9370DB" stroke="#8A2BE2" stroke-width="3"/>
    <!-- Snout -->
    <ellipse cx="150" cy="-80" rx="20" ry="15" fill="#BAA2DE"/>
    <!-- Eyes -->
    <circle cx="105" cy="-90" r="10" fill="white"/>
    <circle cx="135" cy="-90" r="10" fill="white"/>
    <circle cx="105" cy="-90" r="5" fill="#222"/>
    <circle cx="135" cy="-90" r="5" fill="#222"/>
    <!-- Horns -->
    <path d="M100 -110 Q90 -130, 100 -140 Q110 -130, 120 -110 Z" fill="#E0BBE4"/>
    <path d="M130 -110 Q140 -130, 130 -140 Q120 -130, 110 -110 Z" fill="#E0BBE4"/>
    <!-- Wings -->
    <path d="M0 -50 Q-50 -120, -150 -100 L-120 -50 Q-70 0, 0 -50 Z" fill="#C7B4DE" opacity="0.7" stroke="#8A2BE2" stroke-width="2"/>
    <path d="M10 -60 Q60 -130, 160 -110 L130 -60 Q80 -10, 10 -60 Z" fill="#C7B4DE" opacity="0.7" stroke="#8A2BE2" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- Tail -->
    <path d="M-100 0 C-150 50, -180 100, -150 150 C-120 180, -80 170, -50 120 Z" fill="#9370DB" stroke="#8A2BE2" stroke-width="3"/>
  </g>
</svg>

title: Mountain Sunset Serenity
description: A vibrant sunset painting over a majestic mountain range. The sky transitions from deep purples to fiery oranges and yellows, with a glowing sun dipping behind the silhouetted peaks. The mountains are rendered in deep, overlapping shades of blue-grey, creating a sense of depth and tranquility. Subtle animation makes the sun gently pulsate and the colors shift.
svg_content:
<svg width="800" height="600" viewBox="0 0 800 600" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="sunGradient" cx="50%" cy="100%" r="75%" fx="50%" fy="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFD700" />
      <stop offset="20%" stop-color="#FFA500" />
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#FF4500" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#8B0000" />
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="skyGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#4682B4" />
      <stop offset="40%" stop-color="#8A2BE2" />
      <stop offset="70%" stop-color="#FF6347" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFD700" />
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Sky -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="800" height="600" fill="url(#skyGradient)" />

  <!-- Sun -->
  <circle cx="400" cy="550" r="180" fill="url(#sunGradient)">
    <animate attributeName="r" from="180" to="190" dur="4s" begin="0s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    <animate attributeName="cy" from="550" to="545" dur="4s" begin="0s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
  </circle>

title: Cute Fluffy Kitten
description: A charming illustration of a fluffy kitten, rendered with soft lines and a warm color palette. The kitten has large, innocent eyes and a tiny pink nose, sitting comfortably with its tail curled. The background suggests a cozy indoor setting with subtle patterns, enhancing the overall feeling of warmth and cuteness.

  <ellipse cx="400" cy="420" rx="180" ry="150" fill="url(#furGradient)" stroke="#FFB6C1" stroke-width="3" />

  <circle cx="400" cy="280" r="120" fill="url(#furGradient)" stroke="#FFB6C1" stroke-width="3" />

  <circle cx="350" cy="270" r="20" fill="#4682B4" />

  <circle cx="340" cy="260" r="10" fill="url(#eyeHighlight)" opacity="0.8" />
